goal_level: L3 BMKG grade-basis, calibration, and inspection source scan
source_scope: Official BMKG standards, SOPs, service/tariff pages, PPID reports, and annual/performance reports that can clarify method, inspection, logbook, calibration, certificate-request, and PM2.5 network context.

source_inputs.role: seeded official BMKG grade-basis source routes
22 BMKG rows already classified as BAM by the station-method classification audit

evidence_gate_counts.reader_use: Confirms official standards, SOPs, service pages, PPID reports, and annual reports were tested.
Official BMKG sources describe PM2.5/BAM method context.
Official standards describe operational or technical requirements for equipment context.

evidence_gate_counts.gate: Daily inspection or logbook rule context
evidence_gate_counts.reader_use: Official material describes inspection/logbook requirements, but not the target station's actual log.
Official rule material mentions calibration, but not station-level calibration status.
BMKG service/tariff sources show BAM calibration can be requested, not that target stations are certified.
PPID/annual reports mention certificate requests or certificate output at agency level only.

evidence_gate_counts.gate: Target station names in grade-basis sources
evidence_gate_counts.reader_use: Counts rows whose station name appears in seeded official sources, without treating that as certificate closure.
No public source gives an actual target-station inspection log.
No public source gives a target-station calibration certificate or calibration-status record.
Source-level standards are not complete monitor-grade classification or station-radius readiness.

station_rows.reader_use: Use as source-level grade-basis context: BMKG rules and services describe BAM method, inspection/logbook, and calibration route. The target row remains blocked because no public station-specific record is present.
station_rows.non_claim: This scan records public BMKG method, technical-standard, inspection, calibration, tariff, certificate-request, and PM2.5 network context for the 22 BMKG BAM-classified rows. It does not certify station-specific inspection logs, station-specific calibration certificates or status, complete monitor-grade classification, same-station OpenAQ joins, or station-radius coverage.

source_records.source_name: BMKG Regulation 7 2014 technical and operational maintenance standard
source_records.matched_expected_terms: Beta Attenuation Mass Monitor||Kualitas Udara||stasiun pengamatan
source_records.source_note: Official BMKG technical and operational maintenance standard. Use as source-level technical standard context only.

source_records.source_name: BMKG Regulation 11 2019 air-quality observation and data management rule
source_records.matched_expected_terms: Pengamatan dan Pengelolaan Data Kualitas Udara||PM2||BAM
source_records.source_note: Official BMKG air-quality observation rule. Use as method and source-level calibration/logbook rule context only.

source_records.source_name: BMKG SOP 014 KB IV 2023 daily BAM-1020 inspection
source_records.source_note: Official BMKG SOP for daily BAM-1020 inspection. Use as source-level daily inspection procedure context only.

source_records.source_name: BMKG PTSP service and tariff page for BAM calibration
source_records.matched_expected_terms: Jasa Kalibrasi||Alat Kualitas Udara||Betha Attenuator Monitoring
source_records.source_note: Official BMKG PTSP page records the public calibration service route and tariff. It is not a target-station certificate.

source_records.source_name: BMKG Central Java service page for BAM calibration tariff
source_records.matched_expected_terms: Jasa Kalibrasi||Alat Kualitas Udara||Betha Attenuator Monitoring
source_records.source_note: Official BMKG regional service page. Use as source-level calibration service context only.

source_records.source_name: BMKG PNBP tariff regulation PDF for calibration services
source_records.source_note: Official PNBP tariff regulation. Use as legal service/tariff context only.

source_records.source_name: BMKG PPID public information list for PM2.5 cadence
source_records.source_note: Official PPID public-information list records PM2.5 public cadence and owner. It is not calibration evidence.

source_records.source_name: BMKG PPID 2023 report with calibration-certificate request context
source_records.source_note: Official PPID report context for public requests including calibration-certificate questions. It is not a target-station certificate.

source_records.source_name: BMKG PPID 2024 report with PM2.5 and calibration-certificate context
source_records.source_note: Official PPID report context for PM2.5 and certificate-request language. It is not a target-station certificate.

source_records.source_name: BMKG 2020 annual report with PM2.5 equipment and certificate-output context
source_records.source_note: Official BMKG annual report. Use as agency-level certificate-output and PM2.5 network context only.
